items.prompt: Choose the correct form: They ___ a new office right now.
Write the verb in the correct form: She ___ (make) a cake at the moment.
items.explanation: Drop the final -e before -ing: make → making.

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for an action happening now.
Write two words: Be quiet, please. I ___ ___ on the phone.
Choose the correct sentence for a fixed plan.
options: We are meeting the client on Friday.
We meet the client on Friday always.
We meeting the client on Friday.
We are meet the client on Friday.
items.explanation: Fixed future arrangements use the present continuous.

items.prompt: Write two words: She ___ ___ to Berlin next Monday.
items.explanation: Arrangement with a time expression: is flying.

items.prompt: Choose the correct negative: He ___ at home today; he is on a trip.
items.explanation: Negative of the present continuous: isn't + -ing.
